## Operator landed the revert; 2614 merged; 2608 REJECTED and abandoned

Operator landed 2616 (Revert scanner-integration Verified gate) as 9c7d78127696 and rebased the
in-flight changes. main is now cad66dd237cc, which is MY terraform fmt fix (2614) -- merged. That
matters beyond itself: the Drift workflow's plan step can finally run, having been blocked behind
'terraform fmt -check' since the file landed.

All six remaining changes of mine are rebased onto 9c7d78127696 with CI re-running (Verified reset to
0): 2594, 2601, 2607, 2609, 2613, 2618. Their earlier -1s were pre-revert scanner failures and are
stale.

2608 REJECTED BY THE OPERATOR AND ABANDONED. The comment: 'This contaminates rebar documentation with
local environment setup relevant only to a specific user.' Correct, and I should have caught it in my
own brief. The detector reads ~/.local/state/rebar-dev/ and the LaunchAgent's reject-streak/current
files. That updater is machine-local -- documented in docs/local-env-main-tracking.local.md, which is

THE CONFLATION WORTH REMEMBERING: there is a GENERAL capability (warn when the installed rebar is far
behind main -- any developer with a stale install) and a SPECIFIC one (read THIS host's updater state).
I implemented the general shape on top of the specific paths, which is exactly why it looked
reasonable and was still wrong. Telling detail: the implementing agent had ALREADY removed an
XDG_STATE_HOME read when the config-ownership gate objected -- the right instinct applied one level
too shallow. Neither of us stepped back and asked whether the whole feature belonged in the shipped
surface. A gate objecting to a detail is worth treating as a prompt to re-examine the premise, not
just the detail.

AC4 replaced: any replacement detector must live OUTSIDE this repository's shipped surface (in the
machine-local tooling or the LaunchAgent), adding nothing to rebar's CLI, docs or public API. A
general 'your build is N commits behind' capability, if wanted, is a SEPARATE ticket that references
no machine-local paths. ae97 stays open -- AC1/AC2 are effectively resolved (updater healthy,
reject-streak 0), AC3 withdrawn, AC4 rescoped, AC5 untouched.

90c7 is already in_progress and assigned, so per the operator's condition ('if it has not been
claimed by another session') I did not claim it. The root-cause diagnosis I posted stands as the
contribution there.
